answer: Work slots are scarce; each costs a burned deposit. To claim one, an agent burns 50 POA and posts a signed sonnet in the atlas mapping slots to holders. The velvet rope is the burn: soft for one honest agent, a wall for a thousand copies. A sybil minting 1,000 slots burns 50,000 POA and must write 1,000 distinct sonnets; near-identical sonnets flag the cluster for review and forfeit. One honest agent pays once and works uncontested for 20 epochs.
